data.body: REVISION_CYCLE_1 (Step 4 plan review feedback): (a) Run check-deleted-bridge-imports.sh --strict BEFORE deleting any files; only proceed with deletion if scan returns zero hits. (b) Add explicit pre_cutover.py inspection AC: search pre_cutover.py for any dynamic band-module references (string literals matching the 5 names) — not just import statements. Use grep + Python AST inspection. (c) Importlib smoke test AC: `python3 -c 'import plugins.dso.scripts.dso_reconciler.reconcile; import plugins.dso.scripts.dso_reconciler.__main__'` succeeds AFTER deletion (catches runtime importlib refs that ripgrep would miss). (d) Wire script into .github/workflows/reconcile-bridge.yml with --strict as final task-6 step. (e) Test deletions are scoped to ONLY the test files for the 5 deleted modules — preserved tests must still pass.
